If you’re using AVG or Eset Internet Security, its certificate might be causing Firefox to ask you for a Primary Password every time you start Firefox.

To resolve this problem, you must first deactivate your Primary Password and then reactivate it:
{for not fx152}
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#Click {menu Privacy & Security} in the left panel and go to the '''Logins and Passwords''' section.
#Remove the check mark from the box next to '''Use a Primary Password''' and enter the current password to confirm your ownership of the account.
#;[[Image:Fx80setting-UseAPrimaryPassword]]
#*If you've forgotten your Primary Password, see [[Reset your Primary Password if you've forgotten it|this article]].
#Click {button Remove} and click {button OK} in the dialog that appears to confirm its removal.
#Close Firefox: [[T:closeFirefox]]
#Open Firefox again.
#Repeat the above steps 1 and 2.
#Reactivate a Primary Password by selecting the checkbox next to '''Use a Primary Password''' and enter a password in the window that opens (use a previous or different password).
#Close Firefox: [[T:closeFirefox]]
{/for}
{for fx152}
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#Click {menu Passwords and autofill} in the left panel and go to the ''Additional protections'' section.
#Click on the {button Turn it off} button to disable the primary password. 
#;[[Image:fx152additionalprotection]]
#*If you've forgotten your Primary Password, see [[Reset your Primary Password if you've forgotten it|this article]].
#Close Firefox: [[T:closeFirefox]]
#Open Firefox again.
#Repeat the above steps 1 and 2.
#Reactivate a Primary Password by selecting the ''' Set primary password''' and enter a password in the window that opens (use a previous or different password).
#Close Firefox: [[T:closeFirefox]]
{/for}
When you next start Firefox, it should not ask you for your Primary Password unless it's needed.
{note}For more information about Primary Passwords, see [[Use a Primary Password to protect stored logins and passwords]].{/note}
